def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    objs=[];used=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] and not used[r][c]:
                cc=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; used[r][c]=True; cells=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not used[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==cc:
                            used[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                objs.append((cc,frozenset(cells)))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    midc=(W-1)/2
    for cc,cells in objs:
        xs=[x for _,x in cells]
        if min(xs)<midc: d=-max(y for y,_ in cells)  # slide up so top=0
        else: d=min(y for y,_ in cells)-H+1      # slide down so bottom=H-1
        for y,x in cells: out[y+d][x]=cc
    return out

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    o=objs(g)
    rings=[(cc,cl) for cc,cl in o if is_ring(cl)]
    others=[(cc,cl) for cc,cl in o if not is_ring(cl)]

    grid=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
